scope: Plugin formats, removal review/result and adjacent multi-folder setup
method: Fresh read-only inspection of native source, supplied release-runtime evidence and four current captures

checks.evidence: Every checkbox initializes off; subtitle explicitly states unchecked installations remain; Review selected is disabled with zero selections. Runtime asserts these conditions and the initial capture shows 0 selected / 2 kept.

checks.check: Review before removal and safe keyboard default
checks.evidence: Both selected and all-format actions call the same review stage. NSAlert lists exact format paths, explains project risk and incomplete references; Cancel owns Return while Move to Trash has no key equivalent and is marked destructive.
Only alertSecondButtonReturn reaches trashPlugins. Supplied native smoke cancels the all-formats review and asserts both synthetic installations still exist.

Formats panel fixes content width at 740 points; title is bounded with a full tooltip; checkbox/path rows compress horizontally. Current long-name capture remains within the parent and keeps footer actions visible. Review paths wrap in a fixed-size selectable scroll area.

Panel has 24-point outer insets, 16-point major spacing and 14-point installation row spacing. Labels and action controls do not overlap in reviewed captures; installation choice and exact path are visually paired.

During work selections/Done are disabled. Result capture reports one moved, zero failed, one kept; removed installation is disabled, survivor stays available. Source retains explicit per-path errors in a separate scrollable alert when removal fails.

Native checkboxes expose Remove plus full format/path labels, avoiding ambiguity between installations. Standard buttons preserve native semantics. Long visible labels have selectable path text and tooltips.

Add folders copy communicates additive selection; NSOpenPanel allowsMultipleSelection. Category counts and ten-row scrollable fixture are visible; full path truncation preserves Remove controls within the 740-point sheet, and edit focus returns to the relevant Add button.

Supplied runtime reports grouped-format selection, cancel preservation and selective/whole-product Trash operations using synthetic fixtures only. Source verifies the remaining grouped product survives selective removal.

nonblocking_followups: A future explicit Moved to Trash badge per disabled row would distinguish successful removal more clearly than disabled styling alone; current result totals remain clear.
Consider adding an accessibility label to confirmation and error path text views, and announcing completed removal once, without repeated progress announcements.
limits: Reviewer did not independently execute destructive actions; supplied runtime used synthetic fixtures only
No full keyboard-tab-loop exercise by reviewer
Native multi-selection open panel was source-inspected rather than driven
Review does not replace filesystem safety/security review
